news.title: California helicopter crash kills 2 people, leaves 2 hospitalized and 1 missing
news.summary: A medical helicopter transporting a patient crashed off Catalina Island near Los Angeles, killing two people and leaving two hospitalized, authorities said Thursday. Rescuers continued searching Thursday for a fifth person who was aboard the aircraft and went missing after the Wednesday night crash.
